enabled.label: Cosmetics drop (off: every cosmetic owned, as before)
enabled.description: Turning it off brings back everything you wore: the saves keep your picks.

mode.label: How they drop
mode.description: target: each from its own source, as a Sealed Cosmetic. box: Cosmetic Caches that give a random one. hybrid: both.

target.label: Target farming
target.description: Each cosmetic drops from one source that fits it: Sirus's from Sirus, a league's from its content, the rest from a map tileset. /cosmetics where <name> tells you where. Chances are 1 in X per kill; 0: never.

pinnacle.label: Pinnacle and league bosses (the Shaper, Sirus, Kitava...): 1 in

mapBoss.label: Map bosses and other unique monsters: 1 in

strongbox.label: Strongboxes: 1 in
strongbox.description: Private build. Strongbox cosmetics, else the tileset's.

leagueMonsters.label: League monsters (Legion, Breach, Delirium...) drop this many times as often

onlyNew.label: Only cosmetics you don't own yet

fallbackUnbuilt.label: League content the server doesn't run yet drops its cosmetics in a fitting tileset
fallbackUnbuilt.description: Sanctum's in temples, Ultimatum's in dungeons, Ritual's in forests and so on.

tilesetForOtherMaps.label: A map no tileset names counts as one anyway (chosen by its name)

sealedItem.label: Drop as a Sealed Cosmetic (right click to unlock)
sealedItem.description: Off: it unlocks at once when the monster dies.

sealedNote.label: Sealed Cosmetics say where they dropped
sealedNote.description: A note on the item: what dropped it, how many cosmetics drop there, and how many of those you have unlocked.

sources.label: Per source: drop chance multiplier
sources.description: 0 turns a source off, 2 doubles it. E.g. sirus: 2.

moves.label: Move a cosmetic or a whole set to another source
moves.description: Key: a cosmetic's name or its set's (e.g. "Kitava"). Value: the source.

box.label: Cosmetic Caches
box.description: The box: a Cosmetic Cache drops, a right click unlocks a random cosmetic. Chances are 1 in X; 0: never.

onlyNew.label: Only cosmetics you don't own yet

priceWeights.label: Pricier cosmetics are rarer from caches
priceWeights.description: By the shop's price: wings at 640 points are much rarer than a 50-point effect. Supporter-pack pieces count as expensive.

priceStrength.label: How much rarer (0: price doesn't matter, 2: far rarer)

foundHideouts.label: Hideouts found in maps must drop
foundHideouts.description: The default and campaign hideouts are always yours.

decorations.label: Shop hideout decorations must drop
decorations.description: The masters' decorations are always yours.

mysteryBoxes.label: Mystery boxes drop too
mysteryBoxes.description: Opening one goes through the offline shop: turn on "Keep the offline shop's grants" as well.

upgradeScrolls.label: Upgrade scrolls drop too
upgradeScrolls.description: The shop's upgrade and convert scrolls (Pet Upgrade Scroll, Goddess Set Upgrade Scroll ...). Off: they never drop, from a source or a Cosmetic Cache.

expiredPets.label: Expired pets drop too
expiredPets.description: The "... Premium Expired Pet" cosmetics. Off: they never drop, from a source or a Cosmetic Cache.

keepShopGrants.label: Keep what the offline shop granted (and its mystery boxes gave)

weaponEffectCopies.label: Copies of each weapon effect
weaponEffectCopies.description: Two, so both weapons can wear it.

invisibleCopies.label: Copies of each invisible effect (always owned)
invisibleCopies.description: Invisible Buff Effect and Invisible Flask Effect, to hide buffs and flasks anywhere.

alwaysOwnedKinds.label: Always owned (kinds)
alwaysOwnedKinds.description: Kinds such as Pet, Portal, Footprints, Hideout Item, Character Effect. Account: the hideout shop rows (the hideouts themselves are above).

decorationsMin.label: Hideout decorations per drop: at least

decorationsMax.label: Hideout decorations per drop: at most
decorationsMax.description: More of one you have add up, to 127. Decorations keep dropping until then.

overlay.label: A pop-up on the QoL overlay

announceDrops.label: Say in chat when a Sealed Cosmetic or a Cosmetic Cache drops

rewardToast.label: The game's reward pop-up with the cosmetic's picture
rewardToast.description: On the right of the screen, as for a league challenge reward: "New cosmetic: <name> (Complete)" and "<name> unlocked!" with its icon. Needs the game's challenge notifications on in its options.

banner.label: The game's "Challenge Complete!" banner for a hideout (and a cosmetic when the toast is off)
banner.description: Needs the game's option to show challenge notifications.

testCommands.label: Test commands (/cosmetics give, sealed, cache, lock)
